name: Sbu Fuel

replaces.name: Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker
replaces.price_model: free download with ads, Fuelly Premium subscription (monthly or yearly) for no ads, photos and PDFs, fuel-up location; account on Fuelly.com required

replaces.name: Road Trip MPG
replaces.price_model: paid $6.99, one-time, no ads, no subscription; Lite version free

replaces.name: Drivvo - Car Expense Tracker
replaces.price_model: free download, in-app purchase for Pro

reference_outside_app_store: None. Fuelly's Android sibling (aCar) is cited in reviews as richer; only what iOS reviews say about it is used (ADR-0003).
one_thing: Logs every fuel-up you type in and closes on one figure: the average consumption of the selected vehicle, in L/100 km or mpg.

features.name: Add a fuel-up
features.description: Date, odometer, quantity, total price (or unit price, the third is computed), full tank yes/no, missed previous fill-up, fuel type, optional note. Odometer typed by hand, prefilled with nothing; last odometer shown as a hint, never forced.
features.reason: Fuelly's core: 'At each fuel-up, just add the miles, gallons and price per gallon'.

features.name: Average consumption
features.description: Full-to-full method: a segment runs from one full tank to the next; partial fills in between add their fuel to the segment; a 'missed fill-up' flag breaks the chain. Average = distance of closed segments / fuel of closed segments, never an average of averages. Shown per vehicle as the one figure, plus last segment, best and worst.
features.reason: The figure the whole app exists for; pure type with parameterized Swift Testing tests (partial, missed, out of order, km and mi odometers).

features.name: Vehicles
features.description: Name, kind (car, motorcycle, van, other), fuel type, odometer unit (km or mi, fixed per vehicle), tank size optional, plate and VIN optional as free text. Multiple vehicles, one selected at a time.
features.reason: Fuelly 'Supports multiple vehicles', 'Store vehicle data: VIN, License Plate'. Free text, no make/model database.

features.name: Units, IT and US
features.description: Stored in SI (kilometres, litres). Shown via Measurement<UnitFuelEfficiency> and FormatStyle: L/100 km, km/L, mpg (US), mpg (UK); volume litres or US/UK gallons; distance from the vehicle's odometer unit. Defaults from Locale.measurementSystem; currency from Locale, every amount with .currency(code:).
features.reason: Fuelly lists 11 unit systems; we keep the four people use. Swedish-kronor and decimal-comma confusion (review) solved by Locale formatting.

features.name: History
features.description: List of fuel-ups and services of the selected vehicle, newest first, with consumption of each closed segment; edit any field of any entry, swipe to delete with confirm.
features.reason: 'No obvious way to correct mistakes', and the log is the record.

features.name: Entries in any order
features.description: Entries are sorted by odometer, not by insertion: a forgotten receipt or 15 years of past services can be added later with any date and odometer; every average is recomputed. Validation: odometer must sit between its neighbours, otherwise a plain message naming the conflicting entry.
features.reason: 24 of 239 reviews: wrong mpg, partial fills, cannot add a missed or past fuel-up, no recalculate.

features.name: Costs
features.description: Fuel and service spending per month and year, cost per km or mile, average price per litre or gallon; 0-priced fuel-ups (rewards) counted in consumption, not in average price.
features.reason: Fuelly charts 'gas price, gas expenses, service expenses'; '$0 fuel entries' and 'doesn't total' reviews.

features.name: Service log and reminders
features.description: Service entries (oil, tyres, brakes, inspection, insurance, tax, custom) with date, odometer, cost, note. Reminders by distance, by time or both, whichever comes first: due date as a local notification; due distance estimated from the vehicle's average km per day and checked when a fuel-up is added. Presets: oil change, tyre rotation, revisione, bollo.
features.reason: Fuelly 'Customizable service reminders, with presets'. 11 reviews say its notifications never arrive: ours are local, scheduled with UserNotifications and listed in the app.

features.name: Everything free, no account
features.description: No sign-in, no subscription, no ads, no nag screens, no review prompts beyond SKStoreReviewController's system limit; fuel-up location as free text, never paywalled.
features.reason: 71 reviews: subscription nags, paying twice, restore broken, location moved behind Premium in 3.3.2. 42 more: forced login, sync errors, data lost.

features.name: CSV export and import
features.description: Export fuel-ups and services per vehicle as CSV (ShareLink, fileExporter); import a CSV with a column-mapping sheet and unit choice, preview of the first rows, duplicates skipped by date + odometer.
features.reason: Data ownership: 'exporting data is broken', 'no way to import from my exported Android app', 'you can't export anything'. CSV is also the way out of Fuelly.

features.name: Charts
features.description: Consumption per segment over time, cost per month, price per unit over time; Swift Charts with chartXSelection and a 3/12 months/all range.
features.reason: Fuelly 'Charts: MPG, stats, gas price, gas expenses, service expenses'; 'the app has one graph, maybe two' (review).

features.name: iCloud sync, off by default
features.description: SwiftData with a CloudKit private database container, switched on in Settings (ADR-0008); off means a local store only. Plus a JSON backup file to Files.
features.reason: 'Switched phones and lost everything' (several reviews) without bringing back an account.

features.name: Receipt photo
features.description: One photo per entry from camera or library, stored as external data (included in backups: it is the user's record), downscaled to 2048 px HEIC.
features.reason: Fuelly Premium 'photos and PDFs'; PhotosPicker, no camera permission for the library.

features.name: Station as remembered text
features.description: Free-text station name with suggestions from the user's own past entries; no map, no lookup.
features.reason: 9 reviews about stations not saved or not found; a local suggestion list fixes it without network.

features.name: Trip tag
features.description: Optional tag on a fuel-up (towing, highway, city) and a filter on averages by tag.
features.reason: 'needs towing mode', 'set filters for my logs and see statistics update' (reviews).

features.name: Add fuel-up from Shortcuts
features.description: One App Intent 'Aggiungi rifornimento' that opens the add sheet with the selected vehicle.

screens.name: Vehicle
screens.purpose: The tool screen on surface: one figure (average consumption of the selected vehicle, SbuStat + SbuFullStop, unit as secondary text), vehicle picker in the toolbar, then secondary rows in inkMuted.
elements: last segment, cost per km, spent this month

screens.name: Add / edit fuel-up
screens.purpose: Form sheet, odometer field focused first, numeric keyboards.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: List .insetGrouped of fuel-ups and services, sections by month.
elements: rows: date, quantity, price, segment consumption or 'parziale'

screens.name: Services
screens.purpose: Service log and reminders of the vehicle.
elements: due reminders with status word (scaduto, tra 800 km)

flows.name: First run
steps: Vehicle form: name, fuel, odometer unit
Vehicle screen says 'Fai il prossimo pieno per vedere il consumo'
Second full tank: the figure appears

flows.name: Fuel-up at the pump
steps: Figure updates; due distance reminders checked

flows.name: Service reminder
steps: Local notification on the date or when the estimated odometer is reached
Log the service: reminder rolls forward

flows.name: Leave Fuelly
steps: Share to Sbu Fuel or Settings > Importa

fields.name: odometerUnit
fields.note: km | mi, fixed once entries exist

fields.name: odometerKm
fields.note: stored in km whatever the vehicle unit

fields.name: everyMonths
fields.note: at least one of the two

data_model.storage: SwiftData, local store by default; with the iCloud toggle on, a second ModelConfiguration with cloudKitDatabase: .private (ADR-0008), so every attribute has a default and every relationship is optional. Canonical units SI; ConsumptionCalculator and ReminderSchedule are nonisolated pure types tested with Swift Testing. A few thousand rows per vehicle: no need for sqlite3.

monetization.model: free download with ads and subscription
monetization.price: Fuelly Premium monthly or yearly (price not in the listing); Road Trip MPG $6.99 one-time
monetization.notes: Fuelly also requires a Fuelly.com account and syncs every entry to its server; reviews report clipboard reads on launch, forced App Store redirects from ads and a claim of data shared with insurers (unverified).

pains.pain: Paywall and nags: subscription prompt at every launch, paid Gas Cubby users asked to pay again, restore purchase broken, location moved behind Premium
pains.evidence: "Suddenly recording fuel up location is a premium feature. Time to find a different app."

pains.pain: Forced login, sync errors and lost data: logged out with an HTML error, years of records gone after an update or a phone change
pains.evidence: "I have 4 cars' worth of maintenance and fuel records that I now can't access."
pains.becomes: Everything free, no account; iCloud sync off by default; CSV and JSON backup

pains.pain: Wrong or missing mpg: partial fills, missed fill-ups, entries out of order, past entries impossible, no recalculate
pains.evidence: "you cannot add a missed fuelup without deleting all of the fuelups after it"
pains.becomes: Average consumption (full-to-full) and Entries in any order

pains.pain: Ads that redirect to the App Store or Safari, review nags
pains.evidence: "it keeps opening the app store asking me to download Shein"
pains.becomes: No ads, system review prompt only

pains.pain: Privacy: clipboard read on launch, public profiles, data sold (claimed)
pains.evidence: "App pastes from clipboard every time I open it."
pains.becomes: No network, no pasteboard access, Data Not Collected

pains.evidence: "I've never received a single service reminder once."
pains.becomes: Service log and reminders (local notifications, listed in app)

pains.pain: Abandoned app, no updates for years
pains.becomes: Native iOS 17 app, current keyboard and controls

pains.pain: Make/model database missing the car, add vehicle hangs
pains.evidence: "It hangs up without loading any model years."
pains.becomes: Vehicles as free text, no database

pains.pain: Stations not found or not saved
Fewer charts and features than the Android version
pains.evidence: "The app has one graph, maybe two."
"I could find no way in the app to import data ... from my exported Android app."

pains_note: 239 reviews 1-3 stars of Fuelly (research/paywall-pain:research/295905460/reviews.json, 235 US, 4 IT), counted by hand; one review can count in more than one pain. The Italian ones add: 'presuppongono che uno debba fare il pieno ad ogni rifornimento', answered by partial fills inside the full-to-full method.

skipped.feature: Fuelly.com account, community averages, online sync
skipped.reason: No accounts, no network; iCloud only opt-in (ADR-0008).

skipped.feature: Gas station map and nearby lookup, fuel price APIs
skipped.reason: Network and location; the station is free text.

skipped.feature: GPS trip tracking, mileage log for business trips (MileIQ, Fuelly trips)
skipped.reason: That is Sbu Speed's trip log; the odometer is typed by hand.
Bluetooth accessory, out of the one thing; a review cites conflicts with other apps.
Needs a maintained dataset; 9 reviews say it is the part that breaks. Free text instead.

skipped.feature: Electric and plug-in hybrid kWh tracking
skipped.reason: Second figure and second unit family (kWh/100 km); PHEV complaint noted, possible 1.1.
Four cover IT and US; the rest add settings without users.
Locale currency stored per entry; no conversion (needs rates from the network).
Mail link to sbu.dev support, as every Sbu app.

system_frameworks.name: SwiftData (+ CloudKit private database)
system_frameworks.use: storage; sync only when switched on

system_frameworks.name: UserNotifications
system_frameworks.use: service reminders by date and estimated distance

dependencies_note: SbuKit and Apple frameworks only. CSV parser written in-app (RFC 4180, quoted fields, ; and , separators for IT exports), tested.

review_risks.risk: New Sbu app while six are in the Resolution Center; Speed (also car-related) was rejected.
review_risks.mitigation: Submit only after Apple answers the lot, one per week. Review notes: a log with several screens (vehicles, fuel-ups, services, reminders, costs), no GPS, no sensor, nothing in common with Speed. niche-crowding marks Fuel low risk (IT niche under 200 ratings).

review_risks.risk: Overlap with Sbu Speed (trip log) and a future Sbu Expenses (car costs).
review_risks.mitigation: Fuel never measures distance or speed; Expenses, if built, must not have a vehicle category with consumption. Recorded in decisions_needed.

review_risks.risk: Using 'Fuelly' or 'Gas Cubby' in name, subtitle or keywords.
review_risks.mitigation: Never in metadata; the CSV import help says 'export da altri servizi' and names Fuelly only on sbu.dev.
On device, Data Not Collected, no pasteboard reads, iCloud off by default.

review_risks.risk: Empty app at first launch hides the figure.
review_risks.mitigation: Review notes with steps (two full tanks) and a 'Prova con dati di esempio' sample vehicle, removable.

review_risks.risk: Looks like a form plus a number.
review_risks.mitigation: Reminders with notifications, charts, CSV import and late entries make it a real log.

decisions_needed: Accent for Fuel (not yet in Design/tokens.json), distinct from Speed's.
Ship 1.0 with or without iCloud sync (P1): without it the estimate drops by 1.5 days but reviews ask for it after phone changes.
Boundary with a future Sbu Expenses: car costs stay only in Fuel.
Default consumption unit in IT: L/100 km (Europe standard) or km/L (common in Italian speech); the spec assumes L/100 km with km/L as an option.
estimate_note: 9-11 days for 1.0 with P0 and P1; P0 only (vehicles, fuel-ups, calculator, history, costs, services and reminders) is about 6 days. The calculator with its tests is the critical day.

source.competitors: iTunes Search API, 2026-10-15 (Road Trip MPG, Drivvo)
